title: 1848 limit number of hexes
body:
Fixes #1848 

We also show error message in admin page when too many hexes:
![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/23f7940e1891dcc76cdc34d85050979e.gif)

issues.title: Limit number of hexes
issues.body:
We get a `call stack exceeded` when we have too many hex cells.

Do some trials to determine the maximum number, and prevent that being exceeded.

Potentially also show some message on the map when this happens.  Hmm, it could even be a popup - since the problem shouldn't get as far as users.

Hmm, it may even be possible to determine this when the `constraints` are edited in the admin page.
